title: Bootstrap new projects with structured and identity-marked roadmaps
abstract: Every new project should begin with a clean roadmap organized into phases, milestones, subtasks, and features. Assign each individual roadmap object a dedicated stable emoji serving as its identity marker, distinct from completion-state indicators.
unresolved: Emoji allocation, identity stability, and collisions will need formal treatment.
Roadmap items are not automatically queued or authorized development tasks.
